item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem:
Trisha burns a strip of magnesium in air and dissolves the white product in water; the solution turns red litmus blue. She also burns sulfur in air and dissolves that product in water; the solution turns blue litmus red.

Which two claims correctly decide whether each product is basic or acidic?

options.A: The magnesium product in water is basic, because red litmus turns blue.
options.B: The magnesium product in water is acidic, because burning in air always makes an acid.
options.C: The sulfur product in water is acidic, because blue litmus turns red.
options.D: Both products are basic, because any substance that burns in air forms a base.
